hints.title: Slope Direction Check
hints.text: Inspect whether the element immediately following the middle index is higher or lower.

hints.title: Ascending Versus Descending Region
hints.text: If arr[mid] is less than arr[mid + 1], the mountain summit must lie to the right of mid.

hints.title: Boundary Convergence
hints.text: Advance low to mid + 1 when ascending and retract high to mid when descending until both indices coincide.
